scripts.vite:build-dev: npx dotenv-cli -e config.env -- vite build --mode development
scripts.vite:build: npx dotenv-cli -e config.env -- vite build --mode production
scripts.vite:build-ci: npx dotenv-cli -e config.env -- vite build --mode production
scripts.clean: rm -rf src-tauri/target/debug src-tauri/target/release node_modules dist && npm install
scripts.test: sh -c 'if [ -f /etc/debian_version ] || [ -f /etc/redhat-release ]; then ./scripts/linux-prepare.sh npm run tauri:dev; else npm run tauri:dev; fi'
scripts.build:mac: npx dotenv-cli -e config.env -- sh -c "./scripts/generate-attribution.sh && npm run vite:build && npm run tauri:build && ./scripts/set-plist-icon.sh && ./scripts/rebuild-dmg.sh && ./scripts/set-dmg-icon.sh"
scripts.build:macnotarized: npx dotenv-cli -e config.env -- sh -c "./scripts/generate-attribution.sh && npm run vite:build && npm run tauri:build && ./scripts/set-plist-icon.sh" && npx dotenv-cli -e config.env -e .env.signing -- sh -c "./scripts/sign-notarize-app.sh && ./scripts/rebuild-dmg.sh && ./scripts/set-dmg-icon.sh && ./scripts/sign-notarize-dmg.sh"
scripts.build:win: bash ./scripts/generate-attribution.sh && npm run vite:build && npm run tauri:build
scripts.build:linux: ./scripts/linux-prepare.sh bash -c './scripts/generate-attribution.sh && npm run vite:build && npm run tauri:build'
